Introduction

AMBITION is a South Korean pre-debut boy group that has been actively promoting in Japan since 2022. Originally introduced as a five-member group, AMBITION has undergone several lineup changes, and their current official roster remains unconfirmed. The group is affiliated with Wells Entertainment, although early activities were conducted independently.


They released a pre-debut digital single titled “Inception” on June 9, 2023, and have performed at various venues in Japan, including multiple shows at ShowBox in Tokyo. While names such as Rookie, Daehyun, Ryu, Kyle, Taeho (former), and more recently Yoonhyun have been associated with the group, only limited information is available about each member’s status, with conflicting details across fan sites and platforms.

As of 2025, AMBITION has not officially debuted in South Korea, and no fixed member lineup has been confirmed through their official channels.
